project_name: Primal Origins Redesign (Hybrid Coaching + Echo Dating App)
design_vision: A single-page experience blending two distinct visual worlds. The top half (Primal Origins) uses a warm, premium, editorial aesthetic (Archetype 1 + 5). The bottom half (Echo) abruptly shifts into a highly secure, dark, tech-forward 'Clicksphone Communicator' aesthetic (Archetype 7 + 2).

primal_origins.name: Organic & Earthy + Luxury
primal_origins.reasoning: Life and relationship coaching requires warmth, human-centric trust, and an elevated premium feel. Flat minimalist white is too sterile; we need textured warmth.

echo.name: Electric & Neon + Performance Pro
echo.reasoning: High-accountability dating app in beta. Inspired by the Clicksphone communicator—sleek, modern, dark, tactile telecom aesthetic. Dark mode conveys security, exclusivity, and tech-forward calculation.

primal_origins.philosophy: Generous spacing. Overlapping images with text boxes. Use p-12 inside cards with soft rounded-2xl corners.

echo.philosophy: Strict grid hierarchy. Density. Every pixel utilized. Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-md). 1px visible borders on everything to simulate telecom hardware interfaces.

surfaces_and_materials.global_nav: Crystal Glass (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Works universally across light and dark sections.
surfaces_and_materials.echo_cards: The Tracing Beam + Neumorphism hybrid. Flat zinc surfaces (bg-zinc-900) with 1px border-zinc-800, glowing cyan hover states, and 'hardware-like' inner shadows.
surfaces_and_materials.primal_origins_cards: Flat solid surfaces. Soft drop shadows (shadow-xl shadow-stone-200/50), warm white backgrounds.

global_navigation.description: Sticky top nav. z-50. Floating pill or full width glass.
global_navigation.interaction: Smooth scroll anchor links. Links must have high contrast hover states.

primal_origins_hero.description: Editorial split layout. Left: Massive serif headline, terracotta CTA button. Right: Asymmetrical image collage.
primal_origins_hero.cta: Solid Terracotta background, white text. Rounded corners. 'Book a Free Consultation'

primal_origins_methodology.description: Bento Grid layout. Alternating text and imagery. Organic shapes.
primal_origins_methodology.cards: White background, no borders, soft drop shadow.

primal_origins_testimonials.description: The 'Editorial Ribbon' Marquee. Very slow smooth drift.
primal_origins_testimonials.style: Pale Sand background, deep olive serif text. gap-32 between reviews.

echo_hero.description: The transition to Dark Mode. Massive stark contrast. Deep black background. Glowing cyan accents.
echo_hero.imagery: Smartphone mockup floating in 3D-like space. Heavy use of radial gradients (bg-radial from-cyan-900/20 to-black) behind the phone.

echo_features.description: Trio of cards: Triple-Layer Verification, Calculated Resonance, High Accountability.
echo_features.style: Control Room Grid. bg-zinc-900. 1px border-zinc-800. Cyan glowing icons. Hover: border-cyan-500/50 + drop-shadow glow.
echo_features.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone or Regular) in Cyan.

echo_signup_form.inputs: bg-black border border-zinc-800 focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500. Chivo font.
echo_signup_form.submit_button: Brushed metal/dark grey with bright Amber or Cyan text. Hover creates a glowing drop shadow.
echo_signup_form.success_state: Displays generated referral code in a monospace font block (bg-zinc-900 border-cyan-500).

global_footer.description: Massive dark tech footer mapping to the Echo aesthetic.
global_footer.content: PRIMAL ORIGINS PTY LTD ACN: 697504993. Legal links, T&C, Privacy Policy, Contact.

testing_requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='coaching-hero-cta'`).
tech_stack_notes: Use standard React (.js), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, and Framer Motion. DO NOT USE .tsx.

primal_origins_hero_main.description: Woman at laptop in a coaching session. Use in Primal Origins Hero right side.

primal_origins_methodology.description: Two women engaged in discussion. Use in Methodology section.

echo_hero_device.description: Hand holding dark interface smartphone. Use as the main device mockup in Echo hero.

echo_feature_biometric.description: Abstract blue biometric circular lens. Use as background or accent image for the Triple-Layer Verification card.
